name: Biofilm Development — Draft Interface
description: Fig 10.2 (panels c/d) — biofilm development as a hierarchical reorganization. Cells attach to a surface (SurfaceAttachment), the attached population secretes extracellular matrix (ECMSecretion), and the matrix-embedded community grows into a structured biofilm (BiofilmGrowth). All three processes act on leaves inside a single `biofilm` store nested in the environment — the individual cellular interfaces become part of a collective (biofilm) interface that couples, as one composite, to the surrounding environment. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics.
